data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew shera, meaning free woman. In the Bible, this name is borne by the wife of Pharaoh's courtier Jethro, and by the sister of Mordecai in the Book of Esther. The name Sheri carries the meaning “Free woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sheri usually hope their child will grow to embody free woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sheri total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
